mapper.update: UPDATE manga_creative_change_set SET status = #{value.status}, result_json = #{value.resultJson}, updated_by = #{value.updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE change_set_id = #{value.changeSetId} AND status IN ('DRAFT', 'PENDING')
mapper.select: SELECT id, change_set_id, run_id, step_id, user_id, project_id, chapter_id, kind, schema_version, instruction, status, base_project_revision, base_chapter_revision, before_json, payload_json, result_json, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by FROM manga_creative_change_set WHERE step_id = #{stepId}
